title: ArchAngel MLD Trust and INPDA: a small first step together

sentences.text: At ArchAngel MLD Trust, we support families affected by ARSA-related metachromatic leukodystrophy (MLD), while INPDA supports families with acid sphingomyelinase deficiency (ASMD), also called Niemann-Pick A/B.
Both conditions involve too little of a working enzyme and a build-up of substances in cells’ recycling compartments.
This shared biology offers a reason to explore collaboration, not proof that the same research approach will suit both communities.

sections.heading: What already exists that we could share

sentences.text: The Natural History of Metachromatic Leukodystrophy Study (HOME Study) and the Rare Disease Patient Registry & Natural History Study at Sanford already include MLD.
Our research grant programme also supports MLD research.
We could start by sharing information about these resources and exploring which study methods might transfer, without promising access, funding or wider eligibility.

sections.heading: What must be checked before we join forces

sentences.text: The stored substances differ: sulfatides in MLD and sphingomyelin in ASMD.
Before proceeding, please help check whether impaired cerebroside sulfate hydrolysis, reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase A activity and gallbladder dysfunction also occur in ASMD.
We should confirm study eligibility and whether methods can accommodate these differences rather than assume resources transfer unchanged.
Send INPDA one enquiry asking whether the National Multicentre Study of the Natural History of Acid Sphingo-myelinase Deficiency in Adults and Children could include people with MLD.
No open questions are recorded yet.
Dear International Niemann-Pick Disease Alliance team,
I am writing on behalf of ArchAngel MLD Trust to explore a modest collaboration.
MLD and ASMD share enzyme deficiency and substance build-up within cells.
Could you help us ask whether the natural history study named above could include MLD?
We would welcome checking disease differences and eligibility together before making any commitments.
Thank you for considering this first conversation.
[Your name], on behalf of ArchAngel MLD Trust
